_comment: Store frames (scripts/store-frames.py): store order, the raw shot each frame uses, and its label and two-line headline per language. \n breaks the headline.

en:
Pick up where
you left off

A clean, fast
Home for your TV

Your photos,
on the big screen

Your videos play
smoothly on the TV

Make it yours
in one tap

Type on the TV
from your phone
de:

wo du aufgehört hast

flüssig am TV

Auf dem TV tippen,
vom iPhone aus
es:

con un toque
